verdicts.reason: A: the flavour pills are shuffled (Honey Rosemary first, Blood Orange wrapped alone on a second row), and the pill order no longer matches the original. The CTA is oversized and competes with the headline, which is stacked over three lines. The circle bleeds behind the CTA and pills, and the legal text is tiny and cramped. B: it keeps the original left-to-right structure, with a one-line headline, the pills in the original order and a clear CTA. Flaws: the CTA is jammed right next to the subhead on the same baseline and looks crowded, the right circle is awkwardly cut and partly overlaps the CTA, the legal text is very small, and the lower area feels loose.
